text: The contrast between the empty meeting room and the engaging R+D exhibit evokes a sense of anticipation and curiosity within me. The first image, with its pristine, unused space, makes me ponder the potential of collective discourse and the quiet before collaboration. The second image, vibrant and alive with information and someone deeply engaged, feels energizing and intellectually stimulating. I feel drawn toward the space of ideas and research, eager to uncover new knowledge, yet I am aware of the solitude that so often precedes great discoveries.
